assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2.5D mobile game empty room environment with genuine alpha transparency. Input image is ONLY a style and materials reference, never copy its logo/layout/people.
Create ONE EMPTY dollhouse room matching the reference's beautiful soft cream plaster walls and finely grained light oak plank floor. No furniture at all. Exact orthographic dimetric game camera: symmetric left and right, floor is a diamond, both axes have image slopes +0.5 and -0.5, vertical walls stay vertical, no perspective convergence. The back corner is centered horizontally. Two vertical cream walls, 3D wall thickness with cream top caps and subtle baseboard skirting. Square floor with oak boards, fine detailed wood grain, a small solid wood floor thickness visible on the two front edges. Make the top plaster wall corner around (768,180), the floor back corner (768,660), left floor corner (90,999), right floor corner (1446,999), front floor corner (768,1338) in a 1536x1536 composition; approximate these with symmetric geometry. Full room silhouette must fit with generous 5% transparent margin. Warm high-quality handcrafted cozy 3D game art, polished physically believable materials, same gentle cream and honey oak palette as reference. Soft even ambient studio illumination and natural contact shadows at wall/floor joints, no large dramatic shadows. NO window, NO doors, NO furniture, NO lamps, NO plants, NO pictures, NO clocks, NO animals, NO humans, NO text or watermark. Very important: NO window-shaped sunlight, NO sun shafts, NO fixed bright sun patches on floor or walls; those will be separate game layers. Everything outside the room silhouette is truly transparent alpha, not white, not checkerboard, not lavender. Output a square 1536x1536-quality transparent PNG.
